# Goodreads MCP Server
Small MCP server for personal Goodreads reading history.
It keeps a local SQLite store of:
- books - shelves - ratings - reviews - read dates - sync metadata
The current live adapter uses Goodreads shelf RSS feeds backed by a local normalized store. It can run against a public Goodreads profile or sign in with Goodreads credentials and discover the profile identity automatically. A Goodreads CSV export can be used as a bootstrap or repair input, but it is not the primary path.
## Tools
- `get_sync_status` - `sync_public_profile` - `list_recent_books` - `list_recent_liked_books` - `list_books_by_shelf` - `search_books` - `summarize_reading_taste`
## Environment
Set either a public Goodreads identity:
```bash GOODREADS_PROFILE_URL='https://www.goodreads.com/user/show/12345678-your-name' GOODREADS_USER_ID='12345678' ```
Or Goodreads credentials:
```bash GOODREADS_USER='you@example.com' GOODREADS_PASS='app-password-or-goodreads-password' ```
Optional settings:
```bash GOODREADS_SHELVES='read,currently-reading,to-read' GOODREADS_AUTO_REFRESH_MINUTES='0' GOODREADS_SYNC_PAGE_LIMIT='10' GOODREADS_PER_PAGE='100' GOODREADS_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS='20' GOODREADS_USER_AGENT='openteams-goodreads-mcp/1.0' GOODREADS_BOOTSTRAP_CSV_PATH='/imports/goodreads_export.csv' GOODREADS_DATA_DIR='/data' FASTMCP_HOST='0.0.0.0' FASTMCP_PORT='8777' FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL='INFO' ```
`GOODREADS_AUTO_REFRESH_MINUTES=0` means the server refreshes on every query. If refresh fails after a successful sync, it keeps serving the last cached snapshot and records the sync error in status.
## Run locally
```bash python3 -m venv .venv . .venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt python server.py ```
The MCP endpoint is:
```text http://127.0.0.1:8777/mcp ```
## Docker
```bash docker build -t goodreads-mcp-server . docker run --rm -p 8777:8777 -e GOODREADS_USER='you@example.com' -e GOODREADS_PASS='secret' -v "$PWD/data:/data" goodreads-mcp-server ```
## Tests
```bash python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . ```
